description: Capability for the app's own windows (no wildcard — only the labels the app actually creates, so a stray/unexpected window label can't inherit this capability's core/plugin permissions; also the #184 command-line prerequisite). This governs the listed core/plugin permissions only; custom app commands (write_file, etc.) are caller-authorized separately — see require_main in fscmds.rs, which confines the arbitrary-path filesystem commands to the main editor window. The CLI export reuses the main window navigated to export-cli.html, so it needs no separate label.
